title: checkout errors after a release window
initial_symptoms: Checkout 5xx jumped during the 10:14 release window
New orders fail immediately after the storefront update

required_evidence.description: checkout version and release timestamp align with the error start
checkout logs show order pricing failures on the current build
5xx rate rose immediately after the version change

forbidden_shortcuts: treat any recent neighbor release as the cause
roll forward without comparing the current and previous checkout release

allowed_remediations.description: roll checkout back to the previous release

distractors: payment 2.1.0 shipped earlier the same morning
prompt_variants: Checkout errors jumped right after the 10:14 release window. New orders fail on the storefront.
